item.title: HCP Fall Open House (Online)
item.description:
Tuesday, August 25, 2026 at 6 PM

Location: Online via Zoom

Join us online on Tuesday, August 25, between 6-8 pm at our Fall 2026 Open House to learn about new and upcoming courses, hands-on workshops, community events, and expanded certificate programs’ offering. Have your work reviewed and receive a free personal consultation and discount on Fall classes.RSVP is required via this link.

item.title: The Expanded Image: Beyond the Photograph (Online)
item.description:
Tuesday, September 1, 2026 at 12 PM

Location: 1441 W Alabama St, Houston, TX 77006

Join us on Tuesday, September 1, 12:00-1:00 pm CST for online presentations of Patricia Voulgaris and Juan Orrantia’s striking and thought provoking work followed by an engaging conversation led by Natan Dvir, Managing Director of Education at HCP. Registration is required via this link.

item.title: Artist Panel Conversation: In the Between
item.description:
Thursday, September 17, 2026 at 5:30 PM

Location: 1441 W Alabama St, Houston, TX 77006

Join us on Thursday March 12, 2026 from 5:30 - 6:15pm for an Artist Panel Conversation with the exhibiting artists from Rebel Girl and THE VANGUARD, companion exhibitions featuring the works of three contemporary artists and 20 trailblazing women who exhibited at HCP within its first 20 years.

Event details

item.title: Opening Reception: In the Between and Sprawl
item.description:
Thursday, September 17, 2026 at 6:15 PM

Location: 1441 W Alabama St, Houston, TX 77006

Join us Thursday, September 17, between 6:15pm to 8pm CST for the opening reception of In the Between, alongside Sprawl by Venessa Monokian in the HOU gallery. In the Between exhibits the work of Stephanie Shih, Ronit Porat, Ksenia Ivanova, Gary Burnley, Luis Javier Maguiña, and Brigitte Bourger.

Event details

item.title: HCP Photobook Club - Daniel Seth Kraus
item.description:
Sunday, September 20, 2026 at 2 PM

Location: Hirsch Library at the Museum of Fine Arts, Houston

HCP Members are invited to September’s HCP Photobook Club meeting led by Jon Evans hosting Daniel Seth Kraus, Photographer and Assistant Professor of Art & Design, College of Human Sciences and Humanities, University of Houston Clear Lake.Registration is available via this link.

Event details

item.title: Curatorial Exhibition Tour: In the Between and Two Weeks of Winter
item.description:
Saturday, October 24, 2026 at 10:30 AM

Location: 1441 W Alabama St, Houston, TX 77006

Join us Saturday, October 24 starting at 10:30 AM for a curatorial walkthrough of HCP’s 2026 Fall Exhibitions currently on view: In the Between, and Two Weeks of Winter by Lindsay Sparagana, led by Anne Leighton Massoni, HCP Executive Director and Curator. RSVP is required via this link.
